scene: You climb the rusty ladder onto a bustling rooftop transit deck.
picture: Side view along a rooftop platform line. At far left sits a yellow bicycle rickshaw. Left of centre, you stand by an open ladder hatch in your straw hat and red poncho with guitar slung behind. Up high at centre right, a neon ferris wheel gondola hovers open. At far right waits a brass book cart lift.
